# VSMECAP
> VSMECAP is the VSME value chain cap platform. The cap that stops spreadsheet chaos.

## What is the VSME Value Chain Cap
Under Directive (EU) 2026/470 Omnibus which entered into force 18 March 2026, companies with less than 1000 employees and less than EUR 450m turnover are protected undertakings. Per Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1560 Annex II which entered into force 24 September 2026, large CSRD-obligated buyers cannot demand sustainability data beyond VSME Basic B1-B11 own-walls Scope 1+2.

## What does VSME B1-B11 ask
B1-B2 disclosures and B3-B11 basic metrics: energy kWh and fuel types for Scope 1+2, workforce headcount and health and safety incidents, basic governance yes/no confirmations.

## What is vsmecap.com
vsmecap.com is VSMECAP, a proposed Workiva-compatible workflow concept to produce a single reusable ESG Passport mapped to VSME B1-B11 and generate a legal refusal letter when a request exceeds the cap. Concept subject to technical review and Marketplace listing acceptance. Not affiliated with Workiva Inc.
